fig.start.description: Fighters share an unparalleled mastery with weapons and armor, and a thorough knowledge of the skills of combat. They are well acquainted with death, both meting it out and staring it defiantly in the face.
bonuses: Light and Medium Armor and Shields available to use
Simple and Martial Weapons available to use

fig.wmg1.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options. You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once

bonuses: +2 Armor Rating every 10 AR.
+2 bonus to attack rolls to two-handed weapons wielded
+2 bonus to attack rolls you make with thrown weapons.
+2 bonus to attack rolls when you have a offhand weapon
+2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

fig.secondw1.description: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.
bonuses: side action to regain hit points equal to d10 + your level
+2 ability score improvement

fig.actions1.description: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.
bonuses: used as as side action, you can take one additional main action

bbr.headlong1.description: You head charge into your foes.
bonuses: Charge up to 10 m; builds 1 Rage on impact, 2 if you are struck during the charge.

bbr.unmake1.description: Spend all Rage on one strike
bonuses: +1d6 damage per 2 Rage spent. Rage drops to 0.

bbr.blooded1.description: At 5 Rage or more, melee attacks deal extra damage
bonuses: if rage >= 5, +1d4 damage.

bbr.berserker1.description: Lower your guard until your next turn
bonuses: Side action: lower your guard until your next turn. Armour halved; every hit you take builds 1 extra Rage.

bbr.pastred1.description: You feel the rage flowing from you.
bonuses: Passive: while Rage is 10 or more, damage dice are doubled. A reward for holding Rage instead of spending it.
Gain 1 Rage each turn if two or more enemies are within reach.
Spend Rage to recover 1d6 HP per 2 Rage spent as side action
every time an enemy hits you, you gain 1 extra Rage.
Spend 2 Rage on an Intimidation shout: enemies in reach make a Composure check or must attack you next turn.
While Rage is above 0, hold back up to CON modifier × 2 damage of each hit.
Consume a fallen enemy to restore HP and gain Rage. The corpse's foul Quick is fel and enters
Upgrade to Bite Down, 2d6 HP per 2 Rage spent.
Upgrade to Grudge, 2 extra Rage.
When a spell targets you, spend 1 Rage to gain advantage on the check against it.
When Rage hits 0, make an Endurance check. On a success, held damage lands a third per turn over 3 turns instead of at once.
Upgrade to Headlong, The charge also deals 1d6 damage on impact.
Upgrade to Unmake, +2d6 damage per 2 Rage spent.
Upgrade to Blooded, At 5 Rage or more, melee attacks deal +2d4.
Upgrade to Berserker, Armour halved; 2 extra Rage per hit taken.
Rage gained above 10 is banked as +1d6 on your next hit, up to 3d6. The surge check still rolls.

+1 Main Action

bbr.start.description: For every barbarian, rage is a power that fuels not just a battle frenzy but also uncanny reflexes, resilience, and feats of strength.
bonuses: Rage is available to use
